events.summary: Baseline review of the project-maintained ListenBrainz tags example: registry metadata, package bytes, capability descriptor, declared network access, privacy-minimal composition, provenance/source policy and deterministic fixture tests were checked for the published 0.1.0 example.
limitations: The example emits the ListenBrainz recording tag block; broader MetaBrainz metadata can have field- or dataset-specific licensing.
Runtime process isolation is not a complete operating-system sandbox.
